label: Tree species and models
summary: Which species and which model every detected tree gets in Unity, and at what size: set per course in its palette.json.
steps: Every stem from the lidar has a height, a crown radius and a kind (broadleaf, conifer or unknown).
A stem up to shrubMaxHeightM is a shrub and only races against shrub assets; taller stems race against the tree assets.
A broadleaf or conifer stem keeps only assets of its kind; an unknown one (under 4 m, or any outer tree) keeps both.
Each asset is scaled to fit the stem's height and crown width (between minScale and maxScale); the fit gives a score.
Inside a drawn tree species area its mix picks the species (by weight), and the fit only decides the size.
Elsewhere the species weights pick among the assets that fit within speciesFitSlack of the best one. Unknown-kind stems skip the weights: the best fit wins.
Stems with at least woodlandMinNeighbours others within woodlandRadiusM are woodland: wider crowns, a size boost and a looser species fit.
Among close fits (variationBand) a deterministic hash of the stem picks the model, its rotation, jitter and lean, so a re-plant gives the same forest.
A fit worse than maxHeightError / maxWidthError, or an unknown kind, is planted but flagged for review.
